activity.notes: Publius Cornelius Scipio Africanus received extraordinary command in Spain in 210 BCE, won the Spanish campaign, carried the war to Africa, defeated Hannibal at Zama in 202 BCE, and concluded the war settlement in 201 BCE. ATLAS uses one representative Roman Republic military-activity interval rather than encoding each magistracy or later advisory role as a separate Activity.

sources.title: Cornelius Scipio Africanus, Publius, 'the elder' — Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: Oxford Classical Dictionary records Scipio's appointment by the Roman people to command in Spain in 210 BCE and his subsequent victories in the Second Punic War.

sources.title: Hannibal and Scipio Meet and Fight at Last — Cambridge University Press
sources.citation_text: Cambridge's study of Hannibal and Scipio describes Scipio's African campaign and decisive victory at Zama in 202 BCE that led to Carthaginian acceptance of Roman peace terms.
